extracted.name: Simple Moscow Mule
extracted.description: This Moscow mule cocktail is made with a 2-1 ratio of ginger beer to vodka, plus the juice of half a lime. Serve it in a copper mug to keep it cold!
ingredient_lines: 4 fluid ounces ginger beer, or to taste
instruction_lines: Fill a tall glass with ice. Pour in lime juice, then vodka, then ginger beer. Garnish with lime slices.
